**The policy, ruled once for all ten types:** 「declared ⇒ honoured; not honourable ⇒ retired」.

## Scope — two types, one PR

**Group D — `doc` · `external_catalog`.** The ruling, verbatim: 「no stack collection exists to create into, so **the declaration is a promise nothing can keep** ⇒ **retire** (`allowRuntimeCreate: false`) in one PR, as 阶段姿态 prescribes (「按发布批量退役，不一键一卡」), with the **ADR-0087 disposition marker**」.

## ⛔ The refused alternative, named so it is not rediscovered

⛔ **Not 「create the collection」.** The ruling rejects that in those words. A seat that reads this card as 「add the missing stack collection」 has inverted it.

## ⚠️ This is a narrowing of a published declaration

`allowRuntimeCreate: true` → `false` **removes** a declared capability. Expect `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` — the value is the claiming seat's to declare, but the direction is not in doubt, and ⛔ it must not be written as though nothing moved. The ADR-0087 disposition marker the ruling names is what records it.

⭐ A narrowing is only cheap when the set it removes is empty. Here it is: there is **no collection to create into**, so nothing that works today stops working. Say that in the PR with the measurement, ⛔ do not assert it.

## ⚠️ The ruling's own NOT MEASURED, carried in unchanged

> Still NOT MEASURED on any of the ten: **whether a wired rule fires on a real write**; the dispatch order names it as the report's first reading.

⇒ acceptance is behavioural. ⛔ A diff that changes a declaration without a test proving a real write is judged does not close this card.
